rationale: wu_2015_trainable-claude-agentic: wu_n_bands=6, wu_n_outer=2, wu_motion_range=8, wu_motion_window=2, epochs=12, batch_size=1, lr=7e-05, weight_decay=0.0, loss_base=mse, lambda_neg=0.7, wu_soft_thresh=0.0008, wu_sigmoid_slope=10.0, wu_sigmoid_offset=1.0, wu_band_scale=1.0, wu_residual_blend=1.0, train_n=600, val_n=200, val_chunk=4, seed=42, rationale=ITER-11 (one knob vs iter-7 best). NUMBERS: firm plateau hr=0.3035 across lr(7-8.5e-5) and lambda_neg(0.4 tie=0.7) -> lr LOCKED 7e-5, lambda_neg back to 0.7 (non-binding, revert to TPE value). FAILURE MODE: continuous training knobs mapped, hr stuck 0.3035. Next lever = wu_soft_thresh, the INIT of the per-outer-iter residual soft-threshold (the optimizer then learns it, but init sets the basin). Base 0.0015. ONE KNOB: wu_soft_thresh 0.0015 -> 0.0008 (lighter init, NO param change, 12 params, lr locked 7e-5). HYPOTHESIS: if the residual soft-threshold starts lighter (0.0008) I expect val hr >= 0.3035 because less aggressive thresholding lets more genuine aliasing-residual structure survive into the refinement add-back, and the low-lr optimizer keeps it near this basin; risk = more noise passes through (hr down) -> heavier thresh confirmed. Budget: ~819s.
